target_customer: AI and medical device developers, life sciences and biopharma teams, and researchers who buy de-identified medical imaging data; hospitals and imaging providers supply it
problem: Developers of medical AI struggle to get large, diverse, de-identified and standardized imaging data linked to reports and clinical records.
business_model: Data licensing: customers pay for access to a curated real-world imaging data network

founders.name: Martin Willemink
founders.background_notes: YC page and the 2022 press release name him CEO and co-founder; no background given in the pages opened. Later sources conflict on whether he stayed CEO (see notes).

founders.name: Jie Wu
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page; no background given.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed de-identification, standardization and secure pipelines across many hospital systems, which is standard but compliance heavy engineering; no research-grade problem.

defensibility.rationale: Each hospital data partnership and compliance setup takes time to replicate, and the network grew to thousands of partner sites per the company site, but raw data supply is not exclusive.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing a large incumbent copying or buying the wedge by 2026; Segmed remained independent.

market_need_then: Medical AI developers needed large labeled imaging datasets while hospitals held the data behind privacy rules; the company later cited 50+ FDA clearances built on its network (company site, undated claim).

branding.domain_note: Uses segmed.ai; no purchase history found.

identity.logo: Corporate logo refreshed in July 2024 per press release; no description found
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and trust focused: regulatory grade, HIPAA compliant, Trust Center

rebrands.why: Company said it reflects the evolution toward imaging data for biopharma and life sciences; the corporate logo was also refreshed

brand_strength.rationale: B2B data supplier with no mascot, merch or consumer press about the brand; trust signals and logos of large customers matter more than the name.

outcome_analysis: Segmed stayed independent and raised a $5.2M seed+ in late 2022 and a $10.4M Series A in September 2024 on a data network spanning thousands of partner sites. The growth of medical AI created demand for compliant imaging data and the company's hospital partnerships gave it some data advantage. It rebranded its platform to Openda in 2024. No shutdown or acquisition was found.
notes: Series A lead conflict: Radiology Business and Healthcare IT Today say iGan Partners and Advocate Health led, Seedtable names Blumberg Capital. The 2022 release says more than $10M raised to date before the Series A, so earlier rounds (YC, Alchemist, pre-seed) are not itemized. A 2023 debt financing from Flashpoint Growth Debt Fund appears in one search summary only and is unverified. CB Insights totals $17.85M, PitchBook about $20.3M, unverified. CB Insights lists two more founders (Wojciech Adam Koszek, Cailin Hardell) but no company source opened confirms them. A search summary says the board put David Gascoigne in as CEO in May 2025 with Willemink as chief scientific officer; not verified from an opened source. No dated competitor sources near the 2020 batch were found; PitchBook's competitor list looked like loose database matches.
